answer: The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in thread, expire in spiral, and hollow lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 15 aliases therefore needs 82 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2393 identities would post 1616 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
